content: BullMQ defaultJobOptions.removeOnComplete/removeOnFail accept boolean, a count (number), or {age, count} object. age is in seconds. Per-queue-factory parameterization (not a shared constant) is required to let queues like flow-run-advance diverge (removeOnComplete:true, removeOnFail:{age:86400}) from the rest (removeOnComplete:{age:86400}, removeOnFail:false).
